name: unpack_bitstream_into_tables
description: Clears a 16-entry table on each pass, then decodes a bit stream using a shift routine, a masked table lookup and two table-filling routines. When a flag bit is clear it copies a run of earlier output back into the buffer, otherwise it writes one literal byte, and it finally adds a value into the table entries.

name: write_status_digits_scan_bits
description: Writes two characters into a text buffer, one a digit and one from a count value, and sets several table fields. It clears a block of table entries, then loops over bit positions counting transitions and makes repeated calls to unnamed routines.

name: decode_stream_and_set_color
description: Program entry that calls the depacker bit-reader refill routine and a multi-bit read routine to decode a packed stream, then writes the result to the COLOR00 color register.

name: close_library_and_toggle_supervisor
description: Calls the Exec routines that close a library and change supervisor state, after testing whether a library pointer field is set. It refers to the intuition.library name and is called from the boot entry code.

name: clear_copy_and_enable_dma
description: Zeroes 8000 bytes of memory, copies a 51-byte block into another buffer and opens graphics.library. It writes the DMA control register to enable DMA channels and refers to the text BOOTBLOCK OK.

name: call_init_then_library_jumps
description: Calls one unnamed setup routine, then makes two library calls through the library base register at offsets of minus 240 and minus 60 bytes.

name: advance_past_string_terminator
description: Moves a pointer forward through a zero-terminated string until it passes the terminating zero byte, leaving it just past the end. No data is copied or changed.

name: initialize_sixteen_table_entries
description: Fills a table of sixteen 8-byte entries. Each entry gets a running value stepping by 256, the value -2, the value 384, and an accumulator that grows by a second step on each pass.

name: setup_blitter_copper_and_interrupts
description: Large entry routine that programs blitter registers and the copper list pointer, sets the DMA and interrupt enable controls, and touches the CIA-A port and the mouse button register. It calls seven unnamed routines.

name: copy_three_words_return_value
description: Copies three values from one block into fields of another block, then returns the value stored at a pointer taken from the first block.

name: copy_text_until_amig_marker
description: Copies characters from a source string into a global buffer until it reaches the marker text AMIG8, then ends the copy with a zero byte. It calls one unnamed routine after copying.

name: find_disk_entry_by_name
description: Clears a 544-longword work buffer and sets the disk sync word and disk length register to read a track. It hashes an upper-cased name modulo 72, then walks a chain of entries comparing names while calling several unnamed routines.

name: match_name_then_unpack_longs
description: Compares input bytes, folded to upper case, against a stored name, and rechecks entries from a linked list while they do not match. Once the name matches it unpacks a run of longwords into a buffer, calls several unnamed routines and returns a result.

name: write_unpacked_longwords_to_memory
description: Writes each longword as four bytes, most significant first, shifting the value after each byte, until the destination pointer is reached. It reads new bit fields between writes and calls one unnamed routine.

name: subtract_stack_arg_if_nonzero
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when its result is nonzero, subtracts a stack argument from it and calls a second routine. It returns the result as a pair of values.

name: call_and_subtract_stack_arg
description: Calls a helper that loads the constant 135, then an unnamed routine. When that result is nonzero it subtracts a stack argument and calls another routine, and it returns the result as a pair of values.

name: wait_then_clear_four_longs
description: Counts down a large timeout while a halfword at a fixed offset stays zero, returning early if the count runs out. Otherwise it clears four longwords through three address registers.

name: poll_status_then_call_helpers
description: Tests a status value through an unnamed routine and, while the status is zero, calls two more routines before returning. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: decrement_global_counter
description: Decrements a global counter by one and returns. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: fill_block_until_zero_value
description: Fills a block of 128 longwords with values returned by an unnamed routine, and ends the fill early once a zero value is stored. It makes four calls to unnamed routines.

name: reset_counter_divide_by_eleven
description: Sets a global counter to 5 and returns the 16-bit input value divided by 11. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Calls an empty stub, then repeatedly calls another routine while bit 4 of a status byte at a fixed offset stays set.

name: write_byte_set_ciab_bit
description: Calls an unnamed routine, writes the constant 255 and then a value from the data register to a byte at a pointer, and sets bit 2 of the CIA-B port B register.

name: set_ciab_port_bit_two
description: Sets bit 2 of the CIA-B port B register and leaves its other bits unchanged. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: clear_bit_wait_for_ready
description: Clears one bit, selected by the result of an unnamed routine, in a byte at a pointer, then calls two routines. If bit 2 of a status byte is set it writes 127 and a masked value, then counts down a timeout while bit 5 of that status byte stays set.

name: clear_control_bits_and_delay
description: Clears bit 1 and then bit 0 of a control byte at a pointer, sets bit 0, and runs a 64-pass delay loop before returning the data register unchanged.

name: pulse_control_bits_and_delay
description: Sets bit 1 of a control byte at a pointer, clears bit 0, then sets bit 0, followed by a 64-pass delay loop before returning the data register unchanged. It is called from four unnamed routines.

name: read_track_sectors_by_sync
description: Steps through track positions, clearing a work buffer and starting disk DMA reads by writing the disk length register for 542 words. It scans the data for the disk sync word, then calls several unnamed routines to place sector data.

name: step_head_then_read_sectors
description: Loops over track positions, stepping a counter toward a target position, then clears a work buffer, writes the disk length register and scans for the sync word. It calls two unnamed routines and returns when the sector data end.

name: seek_track_then_read_sectors
description: Clears a work buffer, starts disk reads through the disk length register and scans for the sync word, then steps the head toward a target track one position at a time. It calls several unnamed routines and returns when the data end or a timeout expires.

name: read_matching_track_sectors
description: Clears a work buffer, starts disk reads through the disk length register and scans for the sync word. When the track matches the target it reads sector data, and it calls five unnamed routines and returns on timeout.

name: forward_to_unnamed_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, doing nothing else.

name: check_signature_and_unpack_backward
description: Checks that a leading longword matches a four-character signature, and if so copies 128 longwords to another buffer. It then decodes packed data into the buffer, working backward from the end, with calls to unnamed routines for lengths and values, and returns on mismatch.

name: call_when_shifted_value_zero
description: Shifts a register value right by a count taken from another register and returns if any bits remain. Otherwise it calls one unnamed routine.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns immediately.

name: shift_bits_from_buffer_loop
description: Loops a set number of times, shifting bits out of a bit buffer and building a value from the extracted bits. It refills the buffer through an unnamed routine when the buffer runs empty.

name: read_bits_until_counter_expires
description: Repeats a bit-buffer read, combining bits with a carry and refilling the buffer through an unnamed routine, until a counter passes its end. It returns when the counter drops below zero.

name: unpack_backward_with_back_references
description: Decodes packed output working backward from the end pointer toward the start pointer. It copies runs of bytes from positions already written or repeats a decoded byte, calling three unnamed routines for lengths and values, and returns once the start pointer is reached.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that returns at once without doing anything. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: unpack_backward_literal_runs
description: Copies bytes backward from one pointer toward a limit, repeating bytes decoded through an unnamed routine and copying earlier runs of the same decode. It calls one unnamed routine and a one-instruction routine that subtracts one.

name: stub_return_single_instruction
description: A one-instruction routine with no calls, text or hardware use listed. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: loop_with_two_helper_calls
description: A 53-instruction routine referenced by two unnamed routines, which makes calls to two unnamed routines. No text, library or hardware use is listed.

name: wrap_single_unnamed_call
description: A 14-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine and is called by one unnamed routine. No text, library or hardware use is listed.

name: store_thirty_two_in_global
description: Stores the value 32 in a global variable and returns. The interrupt request register is listed as touched, but the shown code writes only the global variable.

name: run_block_with_single_call
description: A 49-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine and is referenced by one unnamed routine. No text, library or hardware use is listed.

name: call_once_in_small_block
description: A small 14-instruction routine that makes one call to an unnamed routine and is called from one unnamed routine. No text, library or hardware use is listed.

name: copy_fixed_block_four_longs
description: Copies a block of longwords from one fixed source area to a fixed destination, four longwords per pass over 8657 passes. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_alternate_fixed_block
description: Copies the same amount of data as the routine before it, from a different fixed source area into the same destination, four longwords per pass.

name: draw_text_glyphs_to_buffer
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into a buffer by reading eight-byte glyphs from a table indexed by character code minus 32, writing eight rows spaced 40 bytes apart. A newline moves the output to the next line, advancing by 360 bytes.

name: setup_audio_channels_and_tables
description: Sets the location, length and period registers of four audio channels to one shared sample pointer, length 4 and period 0. It walks pointer tables in memory, calls four unnamed routines, and returns the input value with one bit cleared.

name: stub_two_instruction_routine
description: A two-instruction routine called from one unnamed routine. The listed facts show no calls, text or hardware use, and the shown body repeats the routine before it, so its own behaviour is not confirmed here.

name: setup_audio_channels_with_dma
description: Sets the location, length and period registers of four audio channels to one shared sample pointer, length 4 and period 0, and walks pointer tables in memory. It calls four unnamed routines and touches the DMA control, interrupt enable and CIA-A registers as listed.

name: reset_channel_state_structure
description: Stores a value at offset 6 of a structure and a field from a second structure at offset 44. It sets a byte at offset 29 to 63 and zeroes a series of fields in the first structure.

name: set_control_clear_bit_one
description: Writes the constant 15 and then the constant 1920 to a shared control word, and clears bit 1 of that word. The CIA-A port, DMA control and interrupt enable registers are listed as touched.

name: stub_undecompiled_eight_instructions
description: Eight-instruction routine for which no pseudo-code is available, referenced by one unnamed routine and entered from outside the static flow. No calls, text or hardware use are listed, so its behaviour cannot be described from this evidence.

description: Copies a run of bytes backward within a buffer, with the length set by a register, then decodes a packed bit stream backward into the buffer. It clears a word, writes a control word and calls a stored pointer, or makes an unresolved indirect call when the copy overruns.

key: killing game show, the (1990)(psygnosis)[cr skr][t +5 skr](disk 1 of 2)[intro only]/Killing Game Show, The (1990)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][t +5 SKR](Disk 1 of 2)[intro only].adf:intro:0:0196
name: clear_cia_a_bit_call
description: Clears bit 6 of the CIA-A control register and writes a constant to a register in a loop of 1000 passes. It then stores two words through a base register and calls a stored pointer.

key: killing game show, the (1990)(psygnosis)[cr skr][t +5 skr](disk 1 of 2)[intro only]/Killing Game Show, The (1990)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][t +5 SKR](Disk 1 of 2)[intro only].adf:intro:0:01D4
name: copy_words_from_bit_buffer
description: Reads longwords from a source, writes the low word of each to a destination, and shifts bits from a buffer while a count runs down. When the count ends it makes an unresolved indirect call.

key: killing game show, the (1990)(psygnosis)[cr skr][t +5 skr](disk 1 of 2)[intro only]/Killing Game Show, The (1990)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][t +5 SKR](Disk 1 of 2)[intro only].adf:intro:0:01E2
name: copy_words_with_bit_shifts
description: Writes the low word of each longword from a source to a destination, shifting bits while a counter runs down. It makes an unresolved indirect call when the counter ends.

name: copy_words_to_low_memory
description: Repeatedly copies 9518 words from one fixed source area to a low-memory destination. The outer loop has no exit in the shown code, so the routine never returns.

name: run_copper_frame_loop
description: Sets the copper list location register and the DMA control register, then waits for a vertical position to reach a fixed value. It calls unnamed routines while a status bit stays set, touching the CIA-A port as listed.

name: clear_buffer_then_write_pairs
description: Zeroes a block of longwords from one fixed address up to a higher one, then calls five unnamed routines. It finishes by writing three value pairs to a shared register.

name: build_grid_from_byte_matches
description: For each of 12 rows and 21 entries it searches a 40-byte table for a matching value, then copies 16 words from a source table selected by the match position into a destination grid.

name: fill_bytes_with_stepping_values
description: Writes 41 bytes into a global buffer, starting at 1 and increasing by 8 on each byte with byte wrap-around.

name: copy_records_via_index_lookup
description: Walks a table of records, advancing a byte index with wrap-around for each record, and copies a run of words into a destination chosen by a lookup of that index. The number of records comes from another table.

name: fill_96_longword_pairs
description: Writes 96 pairs of longwords into a buffer, where the first longword of each pair increases by a fixed step and the second by a smaller step.

name: clear_strided_words
description: Clears 97 words spaced four words apart, starting at a fixed address.

name: fill_entries_with_step_constants
description: Writes 144 twenty-byte entries, each holding a counting longword, four fixed words that step by 8, and a value taken from a global table that wraps back to its start.

name: add_table_into_byte_plane
description: Adds each of 64 bytes from a table into every eighth byte of a buffer, starting at a fixed address.

name: fill_entries_from_table
description: Writes 64 eight-byte entries, each holding a counting byte, a table byte, a value that steps by three, and zero bytes, followed by four zero bytes at the end.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry point that decodes as bad instruction data, so the routine has no instructions to describe.

name: load_hunk_file_with_relocations
description: Parses AmigaDOS hunk records, allocating memory for each hunk through the system library and applying relocation entries that add a base address to listed longwords. It calls three unnamed routines and an empty stub, and returns a pair of values.

name: delay_by_countdown_loop
description: Counts a 16-bit register down through zero until it wraps, then returns. The two library call offsets listed as facts do not appear in the shown body.

name: unpack_backward_with_back_references
description: Decodes packed output backward from an end pointer, copying back-referenced runs or repeating a decoded byte. It uses a helper that tests a shifted flag and three unnamed routines for lengths and values, and returns when the start pointer is reached.

name: read_bit_run_with_carry
description: Shifts bits from a buffer one at a time while a counter runs down, combining them with a carry and refilling from a source word array when the buffer empties. It calls a shifted-flag check and a one-instruction subtract routine.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry point that decodes as bad instruction data after a trap, so the routine has no usable instructions to describe.

name: boot_setup_color_and_dma
description: Program entry of thirteen instructions that writes the CIA-B port, the COLOR00 color register, and the DMA and interrupt enable controls. It calls one unnamed routine.

name: set_copper_list_pointers
description: Writes the location registers of the first and second copper lists, then calls one unnamed routine. It is referenced by one unnamed routine.

name: copy_bytes_forward_or_backward
description: Copies a block of bytes from one address to another, going forward when the destination is below the source and backward otherwise, so overlapping blocks are handled. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_bytes_backward_block
description: Copies a block of bytes backward, from its last byte to its first, using a count held in a register. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: disable_hardware_and_copy_block
description: Calls the Exec routine that switches to supervisor state, writes the all-bits-clear value to the interrupt and DMA control registers, sets the ADKCON register to 38144, and copies 256 longwords into a fixed memory area. The final instructions decode as bad data.

name: set_cia_b_bits
description: Writes a constant to a fixed memory address, calls one unnamed routine, then traps and sets bits in a CIA-B register chosen by an index. The final instructions decode as bad data.

name: initialize_hardware_and_copy_block
description: Writes constants to a global and to a CIA-B port register, saves two address values into globals, and calls several routines. It then copies 128 longwords from one block to the block 128 longwords further on, and finishes by calling one more routine.

name: set_clear_byte_flags
description: Computes a byte address from an input address register plus 256, sets bits 6, 5, 4 and 3 of that byte, then clears bits 7 and 3, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: set_clear_byte_bits
description: Sets bit 7 of a byte at an input address register plus 256, then sets, clears and sets bit 3 of it, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: find_entry_and_copy_block
description: Hashes an upper-cased name string modulo 72, looks up a chained entry, and when the name matches copies a run of longwords and then bytes from a source block into a destination. It loops while a size counter remains.

name: match_name_then_copy_blocks
description: Compares an upper-cased name with a stored name and, on a match, copies longword and byte blocks in a loop before returning. It calls three unnamed routines.

name: divide_index_and_compare
description: Divides a value by eleven, compares the quotient with a word in a structure, and when they differ calls another routine with the remainder and quotient combined, followed by a second routine. It always calls a third routine before returning.

name: step_head_to_target_track
description: Steps a position register toward a target value one step at a time by setting and clearing control bits and calling an unnamed routine on each step. When the position changes it writes two control bytes, waits for a ready bit and clears a control bit.

name: issue_control_sequence_and_wait
description: Sets bit 3 of a control byte, writes the values 2, 84 and 64 to three other registers, and waits until bit 1 of a status register is set. It then clears bit 0 of the control byte.

name: write_alt_control_and_wait
description: Sets bit 3 of a control byte, writes the values 2, 100 and 8 to three other registers, and waits until bit 1 of a status register is set. It then clears bit 0 of the control byte.

name: toggle_bit_while_status_set
description: Sets bit 1 of a control byte, then repeatedly toggles bit 0 and calls an unnamed routine while a status bit stays set. It finishes by calling another routine and clearing a word field in a structure.

name: configure_disk_sync_transfer
description: Writes DMA control, disk sync word and disk length values to the custom chip registers, and stores a pointer for the disk read. It then waits for a global flag and a CIA status bit before writing fixed words back.

name: decode_mfm_sector_with_checksum
description: Scans for the disk sync word, matches a sector number in the header and checks a checksum of the decoded longwords. It retries up to four times with another routine between attempts and returns when the checksum matches.

name: clear_and_toggle_bit_flags
description: Clears one bit in a byte and toggles bits in two other bytes, then masks a longword with a constant. The remaining instructions decode as bad data.

name: clear_and_toggle_bit_flags
description: Clears one bit in a byte and toggles bits in two other bytes, then masks a longword with a constant. The remaining instructions decode as bad data.

name: store_longword_set_bits
description: Stores the four bytes of a longword into a structure, sets bits in two bytes chosen by register values, toggles a bit in another, adds a constant to a byte, and traps when an index is out of range. The final instructions decode as bad data.

name: set_word_xor_longword
description: Sets the low twelve bits of a word through an address register, then xors a longword in a structure with a fixed constant. The remaining instructions decode as bad data.

name: clear_toggle_then_add_constant
description: Clears one bit in a byte, toggles another bit, stores a masked value in a longword, then adds a constant to a longword at another pointer. The final instructions decode as bad data.

name: toggle_clear_mask_words
description: Toggles one bit in a byte, clears a bit in another byte, ANDs two words with constants, and adds eight to a byte at a fixed offset. The final instructions decode as bad data.

name: rewrite_word_in_place
description: Writes a word at a fixed offset from an address register back to the same location, then the following bytes decode as bad data, so the routine has no further effect.

name: xor_word_toggle_clear_bits
description: XORs a word through an address register with 12, toggles a bit in a byte chosen by an index, and clears a bit in another byte. The remaining instructions decode as bad data.

name: xor_longword_at_offset
description: XORs a longword at a fixed offset from an address register with a constant. The remaining instructions decode as bad data.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry point that decodes as bad instruction data with no usable instructions to describe.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry point that decodes as bad instruction data with no usable instructions to describe.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Entry point that decodes as bad instruction data with no usable instructions to describe.

name: run_supervisor_call_sequence
description: Calls the Exec Supervisor wrapper, then makes one library call through a global pointer and four unnamed routines. It returns the data register value it was given.

name: save_hardware_setup_display
description: Saves several custom chip registers into memory, disables the interrupt and DMA controls, and writes colour and copper list pointer values. It then loops while an input button is held, toggling a stored value, and refers to a credit text string while calling eleven unnamed routines.

name: wait_for_flag_then_set
description: Spins until bit 5 of a word at a fixed offset from a pointer is set, then writes the constant 32 to another register offset from the same pointer and returns the observed word. It performs no other operations.

name: wait_for_flag_toggle
description: Waits until bit 0 of a flag word at a fixed offset from a pointer becomes set, then waits until it becomes clear again. It performs no other operations and returns.

name: step_counter_until_limit
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine, adds 273 to a counter stored in a structure, copies a global word into two fields, and repeats until the counter reaches 4095.

name: step_counter_down_to_zero
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine, adds negative 273 to a counter stored in a structure, copies a global word into two fields, and repeats until the counter reaches zero.

name: count_to_fifteen_after_waits
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until its result is zero, increments a counter in a structure, and repeats until the counter reaches 15.

name: count_down_to_three
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until its result is zero, decrements a counter in a structure, and repeats until the counter reaches 3.

name: spin_on_self_comparison
description: Spins in a loop whose condition compares a word with itself, so the loop never exits and the routine does not return.

name: check_serial_input_and_wait
description: Handles keyboard serial input: when bit 3 of a flag word is set it sets bit 6 of a global, polls an unnamed routine until it returns zero, and clears the bit again. The CIA-A control and serial data registers are listed as touched.

name: invoke_callback_on_condition
description: Calls a function from a global table, and if the result is nonzero it calls a second function found through that result, then calls a third function from the table.

name: open_library_and_save_fields
description: Sets a global flag to 32 when a word in a structure equals 12850, then calls the Exec OldOpenLibrary routine through a global table. It saves three longwords from the returned library base and calls two more library routines.

name: execute_indirect_table_sequence
description: Calls two routines through offsets from a library base saved in a global, then calls a third routine from the global table, and finally stores a flag value into a global. The listed facts also include a write to the beam control register and closing two libraries.

name: layout_and_draw_text_lines
description: Counts the strings in a list ending at a marker byte, centres the block vertically, and for each string centres it horizontally before calling an unnamed routine for each character.

name: store_pointer_result_field
description: Calls an unnamed routine and stores the address register it returns into a field of a structure.

name: copy_eight_bytes_strided
description: Copies eight consecutive bytes from a source pointer into a destination, placing each byte 80 bytes after the previous one.

name: store_address_word_pairs
description: Stores two computed addresses into a structure as pairs of 16-bit words, high word then low word, each address formed from a base register plus a constant.

name: clear_zero_table
description: Writes zero to 4601 consecutive longwords starting at a fixed address, stopping when the counter wraps.

description: Calls the Exec RawDoFmt function, then measures a 140-byte stack buffer up to its null terminator. If the length is nonzero it passes the buffer and length to another routine.
